description: Versioned checks for resume parsing, relevance, evidence integrity, content quality, and human review.

rules.description: Contact details and resume text must be extractable from the generated document.
Use a conventional reading order and avoid layout structures that interfere with text extraction.
Use recognizable section headings and consistent date formatting.
Keep the document readable without relying on color, icons, or decorative graphics.
Validate page count, spacing, and font sizes before release.
Prioritize evidence relevant to the target job description.
Use important job-description terminology only when supported by candidate evidence.
Identify important job requirements that lack supporting evidence.
Avoid keyword stuffing and repeated claims that add no useful evidence.
Do not invent employment, education, projects, certifications, or skills.
Do not invent metrics, outcomes, responsibilities, or achievements.
Keep claims traceable to canonical profile evidence.
Use consistent role titles, organization names, and dates.
Explain omitted evidence in the strategy report rather than deleting source records.
Require human review when evidence is ambiguous or a claim cannot be verified.
Require final review of the tailored resume before submission.
Validate required inputs, configuration files, and generated output before reporting success.
